# Unnamed
> A trusted-LAN business app built on Toolframe. Its authored guide is served unchanged.

Connect your MCP client to same-origin `/mcp` using Streamable HTTP, then list
the actual tools before relying on a capability. This app has no authentication.

## Domain guides

- [Entry Register capabilities](/llms/entry_register/capabilities.md)
- [Entry Register workflow](/llms/entry_register/workflow.md)
